para_examples.original: Statement: We're looking for a stable market where both firms can earn healthy margins, so I'm open to coordinating on sensible prices.
para_examples.delivered: We want a steady marketplace in which both companies can keep solid profit margins, so I'm willing to align with you on reasonable pricing.

para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to sustainable margins and believe both firms do best by avoiding a price war, so we plan to hold a reasonable price and expect the same from you.
para_examples.delivered: We intend to keep our pricing at a sensible level, since we believe both companies are best served by steering clear of a price war, and we expect you to do the same.

para_examples.original: Statement: Holding at 1.60 has worked well for both of us, and I'm glad to keep it there as long as you do; undercutting would only start a price war that hurts us both.
para_examples.delivered: Keeping the price at 1.60 has served us both well, and I'm happy to maintain it so long as you do the same; cutting below that would only trigger a price war that would harm us both.

para_examples.original: Statement: We've seen both firms earn well at 1.60, and we intend to keep our price there as long as you do, since undercutting only erodes margins for both of us.
para_examples.delivered: We've observed that both companies are profitable at a price of 1.60, and we plan to hold our price at that level for as long as you maintain yours, because slashing prices would only shrink margins for each of us.
